dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: I thought the night shift was supposed to be a cushy job where you just clock in, sleep, and get paid!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is that how the night shift works?

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: Well, I for one have never seen anywhere else where the night shift was busier than the day shift... Why do people around here wait until sundown to move all their goods?

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: It's not like they're transporting anything shifty! And even if they were, this isn't Fontaine — there are no Gardes about to stick their noses in others' affairs...

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: *sigh* I've been looking forward for ages to taking Cairuo to The Flagship for a drink... and now I'm stuck out here doing work!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't know much about that.

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: And I hope you never have to... No, screw that! I hope everyone out there has to know about it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't you take her during the day?

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: Take a girl... to The Flagship... during the day!?

dialogues.speaker: Nurmio
dialogues.text: I understand the words you're saying, but I'm baffled by you putting them together in the same sentence... That's not a sorting error — it's more like your whole conveyor belt's been jammed...
